claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda not an integer, c != 0, F >= 1, 0 <= j <= A: the space Pol_<A + S^j (1+cS)^(-lambda) Pol_<F has dimension A+F and orders exactly 0..A+F-1 at S=0; the relevant Toeplitz determinant is c^(FM) s_(F^M)(1^N) at N=-lambda, M=A-j, nonzero by the hook-content formula.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Taylor tails, dual Jacobi-Trudi, hook-content; argument first supplied by the route review's reviewer. Removes the generic-order hypothesis of the caterpillar component count for monomial windows.
claims.rationale: Makes the caterpillar component count conditional only on the block limits.

claims.summary: The squarefree degree-12 Weierstrass polynomial q of the five-root caterpillar middle component (c_3=-3, kappa=1/100) satisfies no equation A q'' + B q' + C q = 0 with A = S^al (1+c_3 S)^bt of degree d+1 <= 11, deg B <= d, deg C <= d-1 (Fuchsian shape); such an equation exists for d >= 11 for every squarefree q of degree 12. The binary-face polynomials Q_r satisfy one with d=1 (Gegenbauer).
claims.assessment: Refutation by exact linear algebra for all d <= 10 and all splits (solutions appear at d=11, as they must); controls Q_3, Q_6 pass. Covers only the Fuchsian-at-infinity shape.
claims.rationale: Rules out a Heine-Stieltjes (rank-two population) mechanism with only branch singularities for middle-component simplicity.
